bot-disk-quota-settings-panel.title: Per-bot disk quota
bot-disk-quota-settings-panel.defaultPlaceholder: Empty: no quota unless an override sets one
bot-disk-quota-settings-panel.defaultHelp: Each bot's host volume (workspaces, scratch, profile) may not grow past this. A bot over quota gets no new workspace clone and raises an attention card; a bot at 80% raises the card without blocking. Overrides below win over the default; a bot card's container.diskQuotaMb wins over everything. Applies without a restart: the next maintenance tick and the next workspace check already use the new values.
bot-disk-quota-settings-panel.agentHelp: One "agentId=MB" per line; wins over the caste entry.

bot-image-rollout-settings-panel.title: Release bot-image rollout
bot-image-rollout-settings-panel.intro: How the release's bot images roll onto the fleet: a busy bot keeps its old image and is retried until the timeout, then the periodic sweep applies the release image when the bot frees up. An empty field means the environment variable's value (or the module default) applies; the env value is also the upper bound of each field.
bot-image-rollout-settings-panel.pauseLabel: Soft pause after a busy bot, s (0 = off)

bot-image-rollout-settings-panel.notWholeBots: "{{value}}" is not a whole number of bots

bot-lsp-settings-panel.title: Bot language servers
bot-lsp-settings-panel.intro: Language servers give a bot diagnostics after it edits code, at the cost of a TypeScript server (about 1 GB on a large repository) per worktree. Bots whose role writes code get the limited mode; every other bot runs none. An agent card can pin its own mode. Saving applies on each bot's next reconcile, while that bot is paused; the server is not restarted. Leave a field empty to keep the built-in default.
bot-lsp-settings-panel.codingRolesHint: Caste keys (the agent's role), separated by commas. Custom castes count too.
bot-lsp-settings-panel.idleTimeoutHint: An idle language server is stopped after this long.

data-retention-settings-panel.title: Data retention
data-retention-settings-panel.intro: How long the grown tables keep their rows. The cleanup sweep re-reads these windows on every run, so a saved value applies without a restart. <0>0</0> keeps the rows forever.
data-retention-settings-panel.externalBackup: The machine is backed up externally
data-retention-settings-panel.externalBackupHelp: Do not wait for a local database dump: the whole machine is backed up nightly on a separate host. Applies to both the run-context compaction and the deletion of old rows. Leave off while the cleanup relies on a dump in the backup directory.
data-retention-settings-panel.waitingBackup: Cleanup is waiting for a fresh backup — it starts once a backup younger than 24 hours exists, or when the machine is marked as backed up externally.

bot-scope-panel.title: Disk isolation of bots
bot-scope-panel.intro: By default every bot keeps its own disk. A scope instance (a group, a caste, a reporting subtree, a project, a catalog team or the whole company) can be set to <0>shared root</0>: its members then use one directory with one pnpm store, so hard links work across them, and different instances never share a directory. The most specific level wins: the agent's own choice, group, caste, subtree, project, catalog team, company. A change marks the bots <1>restart required</1>; they restart, with their directories moved, only when you apply it.
bot-scope-panel.noInstances: None configured: every bot is isolated.

deploy-jobs-panel.title: Board update
deploy-jobs-panel.intro: Deploy a new image of this board from its digest. Only images built by CI from main or a myr-v* tag are accepted; the check cannot be skipped. The deploy pauses the board (maintenance), switches the image, checks health and resumes; when the health check fails the board rolls back to the previous image automatically and resumes on it (a failed rollback keeps the board paused for the operator). Auto-update without a confirmation is off until the release scenario has run on the staging stand.
deploy-jobs-panel.notEnabled: Deploys from the interface are not enabled on this instance.

bot-disk-settings-panel.cachePlaceholder: Empty: every bot keeps its own cache
bot-disk-settings-panel.cacheHelp: Bots on this server mount its pnpm, go-mod, go-build and gradle subdirectories and share the downloads. The same path must be set as packageCacheRoot in the dockergate configuration, and the subdirectories must exist and belong to the bot user. Applies on the next reconcile pass: bots are recreated with the new mounts. Bots on a fleet host are not affected.
bot-disk-settings-panel.mirrorsPlaceholder: owner/repo, one per line. Empty: bots clone with a full object store each
bot-disk-settings-panel.mirrorsHelp: Needs the shared cache above. The board keeps one bare mirror of each repository under its git subdirectory and refreshes it by fetch; bots mount it read-only and a clone of that repository borrows its objects. The subdirectory must exist and belong to the server user. Applies on the next reconcile pass.
bot-disk-settings-panel.runtimePlaceholder: Empty: every bot keeps its own bin, lazy-packages and lsp
bot-disk-settings-panel.runtimeHelp: Bots on this server mount its bin, lazy-packages and lsp subdirectories read-only over their own runtime paths, so the runtime lives on the host once instead of once per bot. The same path must be set as botRuntimeRoot in the dockergate configuration, and the subdirectories must exist and belong to the bot user. Applies on the next reconcile pass: bots are recreated with the new mounts. Bots on a fleet host are not affected.
bot-disk-settings-panel.pnpmCopy: copy (every clone holds a full copy)
bot-disk-settings-panel.pnpmHelp: A bot container has ONE mount for its whole tree, so a hard link works between its store and any clone. The store must be inside that mount; /cache/pnpm stays a download cache. Applies on the next reconcile pass without restarting the server. Each bot checks hard links into /data/hermes, /workspace and /scratch at start and reports a failure here as an attention card.
bot-disk-settings-panel.uvHelp: Applies to bot containers on their next reconcile pass.
